prompt: You broke a household rule and your sibling offers to take the blame because they think they will be punished less than you. What is the most honest and caring choice?

options.text: Let them take the blame, because they offered freely and it was their idea
Let them take the blame, but promise you will owe them a favour in return
Refuse their help and suggest blaming a different household member instead
Thank them for offering, own up yourself, and accept the consequence rather than letting them carry yours

explanation: An offer made out of loyalty does not make it fair to accept. Owning up protects your sibling and your honesty, while score-keeping favours turn a kind offer into a transaction.
